component.name: OpenSubtitles Uploader PRO
component.summary: Upload subtitles to OpenSubtitles.org with automatic metadata matching

description.p: OpenSubtitles Uploader PRO is a desktop tool for contributing subtitles to OpenSubtitles.org. Drop in a file or a whole movie folder and it pairs each subtitle with its video, identifies the release, and fills in the metadata the upload needs.

ul.li: Drag and drop single files or entire folders, scanned recursively
Automatic pairing of video files with their matching subtitles
Movie and episode identification through file hashing and name parsing
Subtitle language detection, with hearing-impaired and format detection
Reads subtitles out of .zip, .rar, .7z and .tar archives
Handles srt, sub, ssa, ass, vtt, smi and other common subtitle formats
Batch upload with per-file metadata review before anything is sent

description.p: Uploading requires a free OpenSubtitles.org account. The application is also available for Windows and macOS.

screenshot.caption: The main window, ready to accept files or folders

description.p: Fixes the Linux AppImage failing to start for any user other than the one that built it, and stops the API error banner from covering the application header.
